origin.source: Real braintrust npm SDK (not a shim): Eval() over the unmodified email-drafter machine, scoring result.output, the state path, the durable result.events trajectory, and result.usage; runs keyless with noSendLogs and scripted executors

comparison.purpose: Evals over a machine need no eval-specific instrumentation: runAgent already returns the output, the replayable event log, and token usage. A simulated user answers whatever interaction the machine is waiting on, so the same dataset scores a scripted keyless run and a real-model run.
comparison.requires: A Braintrust account (BRAINTRUST_API_KEY) only to upload the experiment; the eval itself runs locally without one.
